name: Glittek Granites Limited
about: Glittek Granites Limited manufactures and sells granite tiles and slabs in India and internationally. The company provides marble, sandstone, semi-precious stone, and quartz products. Its products are used in flooring, countertop, and wall cladding applications. The company serves importers, wholesalers, retailers, builders, architects, and homeowners. Glittek Granites Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
